meta.scope: offline static cross-reference; no device access
meta.method: normalised token match of the airOS knob name (full and last dotted component) against every key and string in the Stage 163A champion
meta.claim_limit: a token match is a CANDIDATE mapping, not a verified equivalence: the OpenWrt parameter semantics were not compared

gaps: candidate mappings are name matches only; semantics were not compared
equivalence_confirmed is 0: no knob was proven to have the same effect on both stacks
knobs absent from the champion may be unimplemented there or simply named differently
